When a user completes a task, submits feedback, or recovers after inactivity — nothing happens to reinforce it. There is no identity tracking, no rewards, no compulsion loop. The user completes work and the system is silent. This is why people stop. This prompt builds the three systems that make execution feel worth continuing: Identity (who am I becoming?), Compulsion Loop (every action leads to the next), and Rewards (verified execution is reinforced).

Identity advances only from verified execution evidence. Rewards fire only from validated system events. The compulsion loop does not create fake engagement — it makes real execution feel continuous. Read all identity, reward, and compulsion files before touching anything.

A user can currently complete 100 tasks and submit all feedback with score 10 without a single real outcome changing. The signal system will show Power or Affluence. Phase advancement will proceed. Identity will advance. None of it is real. The system has no protection against fake progress. This prompt builds the outcome validation system that ensures activity is connected to real results, and the false progress detection system that catches and blocks advancement when it is not.

Outcome validation is the most critical integrity system in Torgima. Bhudhi cannot approve outcome truth. Only evidence + deterministic scoring can. Phase advancement MUST be blocked when validation is missing. Identity advancement MUST be blocked when false progress flags are open. No exceptions.

Three critical systems are unconfirmed or missing. First: Blueprint phases never advance — a user stays in Phase 1 forever because nothing evaluates whether phase completion criteria are met. Second: Starter, Growth, and Ultimate tiers generate identical tasks, identical blueprint structures, and identical enforcement — the tier the user paid for means nothing in practice. Third: The Academy system — blueprint-triggered learning with proof-based completion — is specified but unconfirmed as operational.

Phase advancement is gated by real completion criteria — not by time alone. Outcome validation must pass before a phase advances. Tier differentiation is enforced at blueprint generation, task generation, and signal depth — not just feature flags. Academy only activates when a blueprint step requires a capability gap — it never appears as optional browsing. Read all relevant engine files before touching anything.
